nodes.label: Build workflow (SonarQube analysis)
nodes.rationale: GitHub Actions build + dotnet-sonarscanner analysis; trigger branch set to 'none' (effectively disabled).

nodes.label: HelpDescription (bot feature summary)
nodes.rationale: User-facing help: YouTube/TwitterSpace/TwitCasting/Twitch stream notifications, membership verification, banner change; authoritative docs live in Notion.

nodes.label: Knowledge graph (graph.json)
nodes.rationale: Persistent queryable graph of nodes+edges+hyperedges across sessions; #479 shrink-guard refuses to clobber a larger existing graph.json.

nodes.label: AST structural extraction (Part A)
nodes.rationale: Deterministic, free, no LLM/key; a code-only corpus skips semantic extraction entirely.

nodes.label: Semantic extraction (parallel subagents)
nodes.rationale: For docs/papers/images only; dispatch general-purpose subagents in one message (must have Write access) or use Gemini if GEMINI_API_KEY set. Never reads ANTHROPIC/OPENAI keys.

nodes.label: Community detection & clustering
nodes.rationale: Clusters graph, scores cohesion, surfaces cross-document connections; communities are hand-labeled 2-5 words in Step 5.

nodes.label: God nodes & surprising connections
nodes.rationale: High-degree bridge nodes plus surprising connections and suggested questions pasted from GRAPH_REPORT.md; used to guide exploration.

nodes.label: Confidence rubric (EXTRACTED/INFERRED/AMBIGUOUS)
nodes.rationale: Discrete confidence_score set (1.0 EXTRACTED; 0.95/0.85/0.75/0.65/0.55 INFERRED; 0.1-0.3 AMBIGUOUS); avoids the observed bimodal 0.5/0.85 collapse.
